title: LLM Allocation Uses the Same Placement Seam
summary: Generalized Compute Intentions dev6 binds the existing AI Model Router as an optional router assessment for LLM/model candidates. One whole-candidate-set router decision is made per planning turn and the real candidate/plan/outcome objects are retained.
why: Workbench and other callers should request suitable model compute without embedding provider-specific if/else routing. AI Model Router already owns non-entitling cross-provider model-route choice from authenticated WLU evidence and institutional policy.
invariants: AI Model Router route selection is evaluated once per GCI planning turn, not cached across turns.
AIModelRouteCandidate identity survives into GCI; provider/model identity is not flattened into command text.
AI_MODEL_ROUTE_PERMITTED_NOT_ADMITTED means selected and policy-permitted only.
AIModelRoutePlan.admitted remains false and executableAuthority remains false.
GCI still evaluates its compute, allocation and WLU assessments and the final handoff requires authoritative revalidation.
Runtime Registry acquisition, credentials, transport and provider/model invocation remain outside both GCI and AI Model Router.
evidence_note: Grounded in oorexx_generalized_compute_intentions v0.1-dev6 optional AI Model Router adapter and oorexx_ai_model_router_v0.1 source contract.
